name: Magellan
title: Accelerate your moves and slow down your opponent. Govern the flow of DON!! cards to secure your road to victory!
desc: Restrict your opponent's movements with brutal On Play and K.O. effects wielded by Impel Down Characters, and then go for the kill while they struggle.

cards.name: Magellan
cards.text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a DON!! card on the field is returned to your DON!! deck, this Leader gains +1000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Hannyabal
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 purple {Impel Down} type card other than [Hannyabal] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Ulti
cards.text: [On Play] ① (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area.): Add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

cards.name: Shiki
cards.trigger: [Trigger] DON!! −1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Play this card.

cards.name: Domino
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Little Sadi
cards.text: [On Play] Play up to 1 {Jailer Beast} type Character card from your hand.

cards.name: Minokoala
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On K.O.] If your Leader has the {Impel Down} type, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

cards.name: Minotaur
cards.text:
[Double Attack] (This card deals 2 damage.)
[On K.O.] If your Leader has the {Impel Down} type, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

cards.name: Queen
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Play] DON!! −1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Magellan
cards.text:
[On Play] DON!! −1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Your opponent returns 1 DON!! card from their field to their DON!! deck.
[Opponent's Turn] When this Character is K.O.'d, your opponent returns 2 DON!! cards from their field to their DON!! deck.

cards.name: King
cards.text: [On Play] DON!! −1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.

cards.name: Kaido
cards.text:
[On Play] DON!! −5 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less. This Character gains [Rush] during this turn.
(This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

cards.name: Hydra
cards.text: [Main] DON!! −1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −3000 power during this turn.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] If your opponent has 6 or more DON!! cards on their field, your opponent returns 1 DON!! card from their field to their DON!! deck.

cards.name: Judgment of Hell
cards.text: [Counter] DON!! −1 (You may return the specified number of DON!! cards from your field to your DON!! deck.): Give up to a total of 2 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards −3000 power during this turn.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] If your opponent has 6 or more DON!! cards on their field, your opponent returns 1 DON!! card from their field to their DON!! deck.

cards.name: Impel Down
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may trash 1 card from your hand and rest this Stage: Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Impel Down} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
